flags.message: questions-presented.txt ends with a stray page-footer token ('ii') carried over from the petition's front matter; the QP text itself cut cleanly. Cosmetic, noted for the QP cutter.

Snapshot LowerCourt reads 'Court of Appeals of Kansas' while the petition cover says 'On Petition for a Writ of Certiorari to the Kansas Supreme Court' (which denied review). The docket's reading is the correct one; this is the petition's own inconsistency, not a provisioning error.
